thread:
Ethan (Sales): Heads-up — Glacier Financial just submitted a private deployment request. Wants VPC + on-prem option, HSM for keys, air-gapped install, and strict data residency. They asked if we can do this in ~6 weeks.
Maria Chen: thanks. do we have the intake form from them? link to contract?
Ethan (Sales): sent the initial RFP PDF to #sales (share link) and attached network diagrams. They flagged timeline as business-critical.
Jess O'Neil: quick Qs for scope: which models do they plan to run (open LLMs or finetuned proprietary)? expected peak RPS? max seq len?
Ethan (Sales): they want to run our 13B quantized model variants + a small internal reranker. peak ~= 20 qps sustained, spikes to 50 qps. seq len up to 4096 for some jobs.
Samir Patel: 13B quant + 50 qps on-prem is doable but depends on GPU type and batching. we need GPU SKU, NV driver versions, and whether they allow us to ship our runtime or need airgapped binary checks. also: does customer require FIPS/Crypto-Module validated HSM?
Tanya K.: security: are they SOC2 + PCI scoped? HSM type matters (PKCS#11 vs cloud KMS proxy). audit logs must be forwardable to their SIEM. also need to define key custody model (we manage keys? they provide HSM?).
Ethan (Sales): Glacier is PCI-adjacent and wants us to support customer-managed HSM (they have an on-prem HSM appliance). they require we integrate via PKCS#11.
Jess O'Neil: ok. technical checklist I need filled out before eng triage: (1) model artifacts sizes and file layout, (2) peak/avg RPS, (3) retention policy for logs, (4) network egress rules, (5) install maintenance window. paste intake snippet below:
```
INTEGRATION CHECKLIST
- model_name: string
- model_size_gb: number
- expected_qps_peak: number
- max_sequence_length: number
- kms_hsm_type: PKCS11|HSM-API
- network_cidr_allowlist: list
- install_window_utc: date/time
```
Maria Chen: adding product acceptance criteria: (A) end-to-end latency under 250ms p95 for 20 qps baseline, (B) deterministic fallback policy to hosted variant if on-prem throughput drops, (C) logs and cost telemetry must be opt-out for customer.
Alex Rivera: prioritization note — this looks like a sales-driven enterprise ask. if timeline is firm (6 weeks) and legal + infra signoff needed, we should treat as P1 for intake but P2 for backlog until security/infra confirm feasibility.
Samir Patel: feasibility blockers I see: kernel/drivers (we require CUDA >= 12 / cuDNN >= 9 for optimized kernels), quantized runtime binary verification for airgapped installs, and PKCS#11 shim support. estimating ~3-4 sprints for eng work if infra and HSM integration go smoothly.
Tanya K.: also: we need a threat model for HSM interactions and an audit runbook. I'll need their SOC2 report and network boundary docs. plus approval from platform security for our on-prem agent running with elevated privileges.
Ethan (Sales): I'll collect SOC2 + network diagrams this week. customer is ok with us pushing an install image but not outbound connections except for license checks (to be negotiated).
Jess O'Neil: action items: 1) Ethan to upload intake checklist + SOC2 (due in 48h). 2) Customer to confirm GPU SKU + network egress policy (48h). 3) Samir to draft driver/compatibility matrix (72h). 4) Tanya to list required security docs (48h).
Maria Chen: owners noted. if all docs arrive within 72h, we'll run a scoping call and produce a launch readiness doc with a recommended timeline and must-have vs nice-to-have features.
Alex Rivera: I'll slot this into the next enterprise intake sync on Thursday and mark a tentative backlog epic: "glacier-financial-private-deploy". priority pending security signoff.
infra-bot: Reminder: please create a tracking jira for customer onprem intake and link to this thread.
Samir Patel: will we require a simplified quant profile for customers w/ older GPUs? if so we should add quantization-support task to the epic.
Jess O'Neil: good call — add "quant fallback profile" as a must-have for airgapped installs.
Ethan (Sales): customer ok with phased rollout: MVP (VPC + PKCS#11, basic telemetry) then HSM deep integration later. helps timeline.
Maria Chen: summary for thread: gather docs (SOC2, network CIDRs, GPU SKUs, model artifacts) -> eng feasibility -> security signoff -> estimate -> commit. owners: Ethan (sales) for docs, Samir for infra feasibility, Tanya for security, Jess for solution design, Maria for product decision. target: initial scoping doc by next Wed.
Tanya K.: I'll schedule a security intake call once I have SOC2. dropping here the checklist I need: SOC2 report, HSM vendor + firmware, network boundary, admin access plan.
Ethan (Sales): noted. I'll ping Glacier and update in 24h. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: thanks team. keep updates as short thread replies so we can capture clear backlog inputs. :sparkles:
